description: GraphQL schema for ZO-SENTINEL using strawberry-graphql. Types: MCPServer(server_id,name,url,verdict,trust_score), SignalScore(signal_name,score,evidence), ThreatAssociation(threat_type,severity,evidence), Assessment(server,signals,threats,attestation). Query: server(id)->MCPServer, servers(verdict,risk_tier,limit)->list, search(q)->list, threats(severity)->list. FastAPI integration on port 8788 at /graphql. Daemon uvicorn. Heartbeat. Requires: pip install strawberry-graphql.
